title: HR & Recruitment Coordinator
description:
Job Title: HR and Recruitment Co-ordinator

Location: Thame (Hybrid Working - 2 days in the office, 3 days from home)

Contract Details: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm or 9:00am-5:30pm (1 hour lunch)

Salary: 27,000 - 31,000 per annum

Benefits & Perks:
- 5% annual company bonus
- 25 days holiday plus your birthday off, rising to 30 days with length of service plus bank holidays
- Pension scheme
- Free parking
- Hybrid working
- Exposure to both Recruitment and HR functions
- Company events and team activities

The Role

This is a varied position that combines recruitment coordination with HR administration. You'll be responsible for attracting and onboarding new employees, supporting HR processes, maintaining accurate employee records, and helping ensure the smooth operation of both departments.

Responsibilities
- Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, from advertising vacancies through to onboarding successful candidates
- Conduct candidate screening interviews, primarily via Microsoft Teams
- Support final-stage interviews and assessment centres alongside management teams
- Create and maintain talent pools to support future hiring needs
- Post and manage vacancies across multiple job boards, reviewing advert effectiveness and candidate attraction strategies
- Complete Right to Work checks, contract generation, reference requests, and new starter administration
- Maintain and update recruitment and HR systems, ensuring accurate employee records
- Support HR administration including absence management, leavers, change of status requests, maternity/paternity administration, grievances, and disciplinary processes
- Produce weekly and monthly reports on recruitment activity and department performance
- Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, field teams, clients, and suppliers
- Complete quarterly field visits to maintain knowledge of roles and operational requirements

Ideal Candidate:
- Previous administration experience, ideally within HR, recruitment or a people-focused environment
- Strong organisational and communication skills
- Keen to develop a career within HR and Recruitment
- Currently studying towards, or interested in undertaking, a CIPD Level 3 qualification
- Proactive, detail-oriented and eager to learn

Skills & Attributes
- A positive, proactive attitude with strong people skills
- Excellent organisational and administrative skills
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
- Confident speaking with candidates and stakeholders at all levels
- Proactive and solutions-focused approach
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail
- Strong relationship-building abilities

Desirable Skills
- CIPD qualification or working towards CIPD is desirable but not essential. The company is committed to supporting learning and development and will provide the opportunity to work towards a CIPD qualification.

Technologies
- Microsoft Teams
- Microsoft Office
- Excel - Intermediate

How to Apply

Please note, applicants must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the head office in Thame, Oxfordshire, as regular attendance will be required and must be able to drive.

If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to develop your career in both Recruitment and HR whilst working within a fast-paced and supportive environment, we'd love to hear from you. Apply via this job site or reach out to Adecco Aylesbury.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Adecco. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.

title: Learning and Development Coordinator
description:
We are looking for an organised and proactive Learning & Development Coordinator to join a successful and growing training business based just outside Banbury. The role is full time, office based and permanent offering a salary of up to 27,000.

This is a varied role supporting the day-to-day running of the business, coordinating training activities, monitoring learner progress and ensuring customers receive an excellent level of service. Working closely with the small collaborative team, you'll also support course development, administration and marketing activities.

Key Responsibilities for the Learning & Development Coordinator:
- Coordinate training courses, venues, bookings and learner information
- Monitor e-learning progress and maintaining accurate training records
- Review course feedback and identifying opportunities for improvement
- Support the development and updating of e-learning courses
- Assist with exam marking and maintaining feedback reports
- Process invoices and update customer information across business systems
- Handling telephone calls, emails and learner enquiries
- Monitoring training expiry dates and contacting customers to arrange refresher training
- Support the creation of website content, blogs, podcasts and social media posts
- Providing administration support and assist with wider business projects
- Support the delivery of training when required

Key Skills and Experience Required for the Learning & Development Coordinator:
- Strong experience in administration and customer service
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Experience in delivering training
- Confident using IT systems, databases and Microsoft Office
- Experience with CRM systems would be an advantage
- An interest in training, e-learning and digital content
- A proactive and flexible approach, with the ability to manage multiple priorities
- The ability to work independently and as part of a small team
- A commitment to providing excellent customer service

What's in it for you:
- Salary up to 27,000
- Office based Monday to Friday 9.00 am to 5.00 pm
- Discretionary bonus scheme
- Development opportunities
- Collaborative working environment
- Free onsite parking

title: Recruitment Coordinator
description:
Air Personnel are looking for a Recruitment coordinator for a maternity cover for 12 months

The Opportunity

We are hiring a In-House Recruiter for a Maternity cover to lead our end-to-end talent acquisition. In this role, you will take full ownership of candidate pipelines and partner directly with hiring managers to drive efficient, high-quality hiring across the business.

Knowledge and Skills

End-to-End Recruitment Management
- Manage the full candidate lifecycle from initial brief and job posting through to candidate selection, offer generation, pre-onboarding and Induction.
- Direct source candidate pipelines using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, professional networks, and targeted candidate search strategies.
- Screen, shortlist, and conduct initial phone/video interviews to evaluate candidate suitability, experience, and cultural alignment.
- Coordinate, schedule and attend interview panels, ensuring a smooth and responsive experience for all applicants.

Stakeholder Management & Advising
- Act as a trusted recruiter to key stakeholders, department heads, and senior managers, leading intake meetings to understand hiring requirements and define candidate profiles.
- Guide and coach hiring managers on best-practice interviewing techniques, selection tools, and inclusive hiring methods.
- Provide regular status updates, recruitment metrics, and market intelligence to senior leadership to manage expectations around candidate availability and timelines.

Systems & Administration
- Utilise Workday/myPulse to manage the entire recruitment workflow, ensuring accurate requisition tracking, candidate movement, status updates, and compliance.
- Maintain data integrity within Workday, ensuring all recruitment activities adhere to internal governance and data protection standards (GDPR).
- Partner with the wider HR operational team to hand off successful candidates seamlessly for onboarding and contract generation.

Site Support & Travel
- Conduct occasional travel to our other sites.

Education, Qualifications or Training

Essential
- Demonstrated experience verifying candidate educational backgrounds, technical certifications, and specialised licenses (e.g., engineering indentures, technical apprenticeships, or specialised operational ratings).
- Understanding of standard UK pre-employment screening and security clearance requirements (e.g., BPSS / SC Clearance) relevant to defense or secure operational environments

Desirable
- Degree level education (or equivalent professional experience). CIPD qualification in Human Resources or in-house recruitment is desirable.
- Knowledge of Workday would be highly desirable

Additional requirements
- This position is subject to National Security Vetting. Candidates must be able to obtain SC clearance, which generally requires having lived in the UK for the last five years. All successful applicants will also undergo a mandatory BPSS check.
- Applicants must meet any/all requirements of Export Compliance Regulations.
- All candidates must possess the current, legal right to work in the United Kingdom. We will not be able to offer sponsorship for any employment Visa's.

Please call Michelle for further details or apply with a CV
